profile.summary: The Paul Dresher Ensemble is a San Francisco-based nonprofit arts organization that creates and tours new opera and music theater works and performs contemporary chamber music. Its nonprofit arm, New Performance Traditions, runs an artist residency program and offers rehearsal and studio space to artists.
